The petitioner seeks leave to assail the order dated 30.10.2023 passed by the High Court of Kerala at Ernakulam in CRLA No. 1379/2022 whereunder his application for anticipatory bail was rejected.

entities.text: High Court of Kerala at Ernakulam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The application which culminated in the impugned order was filed in connection with FIR No.
83/2022 registered at P.S. Malappuram Vanitha under Sections 376(2), 366 and 354 D of I.P.C. and Section 3(2)(v) of SC/ST Act.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, Standing counsel for the State of Kerala and counsel for the second respondent.

This Court, on 23.11.2023, while issuing notice passed an interim order to effect that no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner till the next date of listing, of course, subject to the condition that the petitioner shall join the investigation, which order was extended from time to time.
Having heard learned counsel on both sides, we make the interim order passed on 23.11.2023 absolute subject to the outcome of further proceedings emanating from the subject FIR.
The special leave petition is disposed of, as above.
Pending application(s), if any, stands disposed of.

(DR. NAVEEN RAWAL) (MATHEW ABRAHAM)
ASTT. REGISTRAR-cum-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
